lingzhi-coffee-3-en-1.accroche: Coffee, creamer and sugar together in one sachet, with the Lingzhi range's Ganoderma extract.
lingzhi-coffee-3-en-1.description:
The mild version of Lingzhi coffee: the sachet already contains the creamer and sugar, for a milky coffee ready in thirty seconds. The Ganoderma lucidum extract is the same as in the Black Coffee; only the taste is rounder.

No artificial colouring, flavouring or preservative, according to the DXN product sheet. The creamer may contain a milk derivative: check the ingredients list on the packaging if you are sensitive to it.
lingzhi-coffee-3-en-1.composition: Instant coffee, creamer, sugar, Ganoderma lucidum extract. Full details on the packaging.
lingzhi-coffee-3-en-1.usage:
Empty one sachet into a cup.
Add hot water and stir.
lingzhi-coffee-3-en-1.points:
Coffee, creamer and sugar already measured out
Ganoderma lucidum extract, the reishi
20 individual sachets, easy to take with you

lions-mane-coffee.accroche: An instant milky coffee made with powdered Hericium erinaceus, the lion's mane mushroom.
lions-mane-coffee.description:
Lion's Mane Coffee — “Premix Coffee with Lion's Mane Mushroom” on its box — combines instant coffee, creamer and sugar with powdered Hericium erinaceus mushroom, better known as lion's mane. The result is a mild, rounded coffee that can be made hot or cold.

It contains milk (sodium caseinate in the creamer): it is not suitable for people who are allergic to milk proteins.
lions-mane-coffee.composition:
Creamer (glucose syrup, palm oil, sodium caseinate — milk, stabilisers, emulsifiers, salt), sugar, instant coffee, lion's mane mushroom powder (Hericium erinaceus).
Allergen: milk.
lions-mane-coffee.usage:
Empty one sachet (21 g) into a cup.
Add 150 to 180 ml of hot water, or cold water for an iced version. Stir.
lions-mane-coffee.points:
Lion's mane mushroom powder (Hericium erinaceus)
Mild coffee, with plant-based creamer and cane sugar
Made hot or iced — 20 sachets

cordyceps-coffee.accroche: An instant coffee with plant-based creamer, cane sugar and Cordyceps sinensis.

Cordyceps Coffee 3 in 1 is an instant coffee to which DXN adds Cordyceps sinensis, a mushroom long used in Asia. The plant-based creamer and cane sugar are already in the sachet: a milky coffee ready in seconds, hot or cold.

This is the version sold in Europe (DXN Spain 2026 catalogue). The box contains 20 sachets of 21 g.
cordyceps-coffee.composition: Instant coffee, plant-based creamer, cane sugar, Cordyceps sinensis. Full list on the packaging.

morinzhi.description:
Morinzhi is made from the noni fruit, Morinda citrifolia, whose very strong smell is toned down by the addition of roselle, the hibiscus. It is drunk diluted: two capfuls in a glass of water or fruit juice.

The 285 ml bottle should be kept in the fridge once opened. Shake well before serving: the sediment is natural.
morinzhi.composition: Noni juice (Morinda citrifolia), roselle extract (Hibiscus sabdariffa). Full list on the label.
morinzhi.usage:
Shake well before use.
Dilute 30 ml (two capfuls) in a glass of water or juice.
Keep in the fridge once opened.
morinzhi.points:
Noni juice, Morinda citrifolia
Mellowed with roselle
To be diluted: two capfuls per glass

roselle.accroche: A tangy concentrate of hibiscus calyces, to be diluted in hot or cold water.
roselle.description:
Roselle Juice is a concentrate made from roselle calyces, the Hibiscus sabdariffa known as bissap or karkadé. It has a tangy, refreshing taste.

It can be diluted in cold water with ice, in hot water as an infusion, or added to tea. The DXN product sheet also suggests using it in cooking, for a jelly or a sorbet. No artificial preservatives or colourings.
roselle.composition: Roselle calyx extract (Hibiscus sabdariffa). Full list on the label.
roselle.usage:
Dilute the desired amount in cold or hot water and stir.
Can also be mixed into tea or juice.
roselle.points:
Hibiscus calyx concentrate
No artificial preservatives or colourings
Drunk hot or cold, or used in cooking

virgin-coconut-oil.accroche: A cold-pressed virgin coconut oil from organic farming, for cooking.
virgin-coconut-oil.description:
This virgin coconut oil is cold-extracted from fresh coconuts, unrefined, and certified as coming from organic farming. It is solid below about 24°C and turns liquid again when warm: this is the normal behaviour of an untreated coconut oil.

500 ml jar, for food use: for cooking, roasting or seasoning. It can also be used for personal care, a few drops on the skin or the ends of the hair.
virgin-coconut-oil.usage:
In the kitchen: one to two tablespoons for cooking or seasoning.
For personal care: a small amount on the skin or hair, as needed.
virgin-coconut-oil.points:

From organic farming
